title: Press Space. See the structure.
intro: Start in Finder. Press Space to see what is inside a molecular file, then open the workspace when you want to keep working.

features.title: Finder Quick Look
features.description: Preview a molecular file without opening the full workspace.

features.title: Interactive 3D
features.description: Rotate and zoom to inspect a structure from any angle.

features.title: Light and dark
features.description: Choose the background that makes your structure easiest to read.

features.title: Molecular thumbnails
features.description: Recognize supported structure files while browsing Finder.

features.title: Open in Burette
features.description: Take a preview into the desktop workspace for editing and analysis.

features.title: Spectrum previews
features.description: Inspect supported mass spectra in a dedicated spectrum viewer.

title: From the whole protein to its ligand.
intro: Show the protein fold, inspect a ligand, or hide water and focus on a single chain.

features.title: Illustrative appearance
features.description: Give molecular shapes clear outlines for readable figures.

features.title: Representation styles
features.description: Choose cartoons, sticks, spheres, or surfaces to suit the question.

features.title: Scene tree
features.description: Browse chains, ligands, water, and representations. Focus on one component or hide the parts you do not need.

features.title: Show, hide, isolate
features.description: Remove visual clutter while keeping the original structure available.

features.title: Colour controls
features.description: Colour components and adjust transparency without rebuilding your scene.

features.title: Density maps
features.description: View supported electron-density and volume files alongside structures.

features.title: Crystal structures
features.description: Inspect supported CIF structures, unit cells, and symmetry.

features.title: Mesoscale scenes
features.description: Explore supported cell-scale scenes in the dedicated Mesoscale viewer.

title: Pick a residue. Inspect its neighbours.
intro: Select atoms in 3D or residues in the sequence, then measure distances or create a surface around your selection.

features.title: Sequence selection
features.description: Select a residue or range in the Sequence panel to highlight it in 3D.

features.title: Ligand pockets
features.description: Show a pocket surface from protein residues within 5 Å of a ligand to inspect how their shapes fit together.

features.title: Lasso selection
features.description: Draw around atoms to make a selection directly in the viewer.

features.title: Measurements
features.description: Measure distances, angles, and dihedrals between selected atoms.

features.title: Surfaces for your selection
features.description: Create a surface for a residue, chain, protein, or ligand without covering the entire scene.

features.title: Extract a subset
features.description: Save the part of a structure you want to work with.

features.title: Structure superposition
features.description: Compare structures using sequence, chain, residue, or TM-align workflows.

title: Watch a molecule move.
intro: Play a trajectory or compare a set of molecular poses without leaving the viewer.

features.title: Trajectory playback
features.description: Play, pause, or step through individual frames while rotating the structure. The demo shows a 20-frame molecular vibration.

features.title: Trajectory smoothing
features.description: Add interpolated views between recorded frames for smoother playback. Your original frames stay unchanged.

features.title: Pose alignment
features.description: Show every pose with All, then toggle Align to compare their overlap. Switch back to a single pose for a closer look.

features.title: Topology and trajectory
features.description: Load a trajectory with its matching topology to view the motion in the context of the molecular structure.

features.title: SDF poses
features.description: Move between structures in a multi-record SDF, including V3000 files.

features.title: Molecular Stories
features.description: Build and play a sequence of molecular views with MolViewSpec Stories.

title: Find the compounds worth a closer look.
intro: Browse structures and their properties together. Find a subset, inspect it, and export the result.

features.title: Cards and tables
features.description: Switch between molecular drawings and a property table.

features.title: Substructure search
features.description: Use SMARTS to filter molecules and highlight matching atoms.

features.title: 3D inside a collection
features.description: Switch a molecule from its 2D drawing to a live 3D view without leaving the collection.

features.title: Structures and properties
features.description: Select a molecule to see its drawing and descriptors beside the table. Filter numeric properties to narrow your collection.

features.title: Search, sort, and filter
features.description: Find a name or SMILES, sort a column, or narrow the table with a numeric property filter.

features.title: Open a molecule in its own tab
features.description: Move from a collection card to a full molecular view for rotation, selection, and inspection.

features.title: Combine collections
features.description: Append compatible molecular records to keep related compounds in one collection.

features.title: Selection and export
features.description: Export the visible set as SMILES or table data as CSV.

features.title: Browse large collections
features.description: Browse molecular cards as they load into view, without waiting for every drawing to render.

features.title: DataWarrior files
features.description: Open supported DataWarrior structures in the molecular grid.

title: Find neighbours in chemical space.
intro: Map a collection by molecular similarity and bring selected compounds back to the table. Native calculations run on Apple Silicon in the Mac app.

features.title: A map of your molecules
features.description: Explore molecular similarity in a 2D or 3D map, with each point representing a compound.

features.title: Linked selection
features.description: Select a region of the map and continue with those molecules in the grid.

features.title: Similarity search
features.description: Find molecules most similar to a query using molecular fingerprints.

features.title: Clustering
features.description: Group the selected, filtered, or complete collection.

features.title: Choose a diverse subset
features.description: Export a representative set of compounds with their structures and provenance.

features.title: Activity colouring
features.description: Colour a map by a numeric property to see how values vary.

features.title: Activity cliffs
features.description: Look for similar molecules with markedly different activity.

title: Turn a sketch into a 3D structure.
intro: Prepare molecular geometry and run local calculations. External engines are available separately from the built-in Apple Silicon compute tools.

features.title: Conformer generation
features.description: Generate 3D conformers from selected molecules or a Ketcher sketch.

features.title: MMFF refinement
features.description: Refine generated geometry with MMFF94 or MMFF94s.

features.title: Pose scoring
features.description: Compare poses with RMSD, shape, and electrostatic terms.

features.title: Semiempirical energies
features.description: Run supported single-point methods and inspect their reports.

features.title: xTB calculations
features.description: Use the optional local xTB engine for supported molecular calculations.

features.title: CREST and PRISM
features.description: Run optional conformer sampling and ensemble-pruning workflows.

features.title: Keep working during calculations
features.description: Follow a calculation’s progress, then open its report and output files when it finishes.

title: Sketch, edit, and compare.
intro: Edit a molecule in Ketcher, inspect its coordinates, and keep related files open in tabs and side panels.

features.title: Ketcher sketches
features.description: Draw and edit small molecules in the integrated Ketcher editor.

features.title: Edit collection molecules
features.description: Send a compatible grid row to Ketcher and update the collection.

features.title: Sketch to 3D
features.description: Send a sketch to Mol* or a collection for the next step.

features.title: Text editing
features.description: Inspect and edit supported molecular source files in place.

features.title: Project folders
features.description: Browse nested project files from the workspace sidebar.

features.title: Tabs and docks
features.description: Keep structures, tables, text, and inspectors alongside one another.

features.title: Command palette
features.description: Find commands, files, and query-driven actions from the keyboard.

features.title: Drag files into your workspace
features.description: Drop molecular files, collection records, or sketches into the workspace to continue working with them.

title: Connect your chemistry tools.
intro: Ask an agent to open a structure, export a figure for a paper, or continue in another chemistry app.

features.title: Ask your agent to open a structure
features.description: Use the Burette plugin to let an agent open molecular files and work with the available workspace tools through MCP.

features.title: Make a figure for your paper
features.description: Create molecular illustrations with the optional xyzrender engine. Export SVG artwork that stays sharp when resized for a paper or slide.

features.title: Continue in your preferred chemistry app
features.description: Send a supported structure to an installed chemistry application for the next part of your analysis.

features.title: Automate repeatable steps
features.description: Use Burette commands in scripts and agent workflows. Application links can open specific destinations in the workspace.
